title: JustCall Pricing in 2026: Team, Pro, Pro Plus and SalesPro
summary: JustCall Team, Pro and Pro Plus are $29, $49 and $89 per user a month billed annually ($23, $37, $62 on sale to Nov 30, 2026), with a 2-license minimum.
body_markdown:
JustCall publishes prices for three plans. At regular prices, Team is $29, Pro $49 and Pro Plus $89 per user a month billed annually, or $39, $69 and $109 billed monthly. On November 17, 2026, a Black Friday sale showed annual billing at $23, $37 and $62, ending November 30, 2026. Every plan needs at least two licenses. Business and SalesPro are quoted.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every JustCall detail below comes from JustCall's own pricing page, sale page and help centre, opened on November 17, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No JustCall account was used and nothing was tested. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. JustCall](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-justcall) .


## JustCall pricing at a glance


On November 17, 2026, JustCall's[pricing page](https://justcall.io/pricing/) showed the sale price on annual billing, with the monthly price crossed out beside it. The regular annual prices are in JustCall's[pricing guide](https://help.justcall.io/en/articles/10323630-understanding-justcall-pricing-a-comprehensive-guide-to-plans-and-costs) .

JustCall's[Black Friday page](https://justcall.io/black-friday-2026/) says the sale runs from November 10 to 11:59 PM ET on November 30, 2026. It covers new annual plans on Team, Pro, Pro Plus and SalesPro. The sale price holds for the first 12 months, and the plan then renews at the standard annual price. Add-ons stay at standard price, and monthly prices are unchanged.


The page's savings badges of 41%, 46% and 43% compare the sale price with monthly billing. Against the regular annual prices, the sale is $6, $12 and $27 less per user a month. No SalesPro price is published.


The trial terms come from JustCall's[trial guide](https://help.justcall.io/en/articles/8625166-a-guide-to-the-justcall-free-trial) . The 14-day trial runs on SalesPro features. It includes 50 outbound and 50 inbound minutes, $5 in credits and a 7-minute cap on each call.


## What changes the real cost of JustCall


The plan price is one part of the bill.


### The two-license minimum


JustCall's[license article](https://help.justcall.io/en/articles/15923166-what-are-the-pricing-options-license-requirements-and-cost-saving-strategies-for-justcall-plans) says every plan needs at least two licenses, on monthly and annual billing, and that JustCall sells no single-user plan. Its own example is one person on Team with monthly billing, who still pays $78 a month. For Pro, the minimum is $138 a month on monthly billing or $98 at the regular annual price.


### Annual, monthly and the sale


JustCall's guide says annual billing saves up to 29% against monthly. Annual plans are charged in full at the start. Five Pro licenses cost $345 a month on monthly billing, $2,940 a year at the regular annual price, or $2,220 for the first year at the sale price.


### Calling and texting limits


The pricing page lists unlimited inbound and outbound minutes on Team, Pro and Pro Plus, within the chosen region and subject to a fair usage policy. The pricing guide says the bundle covers call routes that cost less than $0.02 a minute in the US and Canada. Toll-free, international and forwarded calls are not covered.


The guide says unlimited calling is for normal business use and cannot be used for large-scale calling such as call centers or telemarketing. An outbound team should ask how that applies to its volume.


Texts sent by bulk campaigns, workflows and CRM automations are outside the SMS bundle. Usage beyond a bundle is paid from prepaid JustCall credits.


### Phone numbers


Each account includes two numbers, one for JustCall and one for the Sales Dialer, whatever the team size, if each costs $6 a month or less. Further numbers are billed at their monthly cost, with 20% off on annual plans.


For local presence, JustCall's[number bundle article](https://help.justcall.io/en/articles/12959562-introducing-custom-local-number-bundles) lists 50, 100 or 200 numbers at $150, $250 or $450 a month on SalesPro, and $225, $360 or $650 on Pro, Pro Plus and Business.


### Add-ons


- **AI Review Assist:** $9 per user a month on Team and Pro. It is included in Pro Plus.
- **Group Texting and Email Inbox:** $5 and $15 per user a month.
- **Answering machine screening and Auto-Classify Pickups:** $0.009 per connected call on plans other than SalesPro.
- **AI Voice Agent:** 100 free minutes, then $0.99 a minute beyond the minutes in a plan. Plan prices are not published.
- **US texting registration:** a $46 brand fee and a $15 campaign fee, each one-time, and $10 a month for a regular campaign.


These prices are from the pricing guide. The license article says per-user add-ons are charged for every license on the account.


### SalesPro and SalesPro Lite


A help centre article describes[SalesPro Lite](https://help.justcall.io/en/articles/14298303-understanding-salespro-lite-full-feature-access-with-3-000-minute-fup) at $79 per user a month billed annually or $99 billed monthly, with 3,000 calling minutes per user. It is not on the pricing page, so ask whether it is offered.


### Cancellation and refunds


JustCall's[cancellation article](https://help.justcall.io/en/articles/1046750-how-can-i-cancel-my-justcall-subscription-and-what-happens-afterward) says a cancelled account closes at the end of the current billing cycle. It says refunds are given only for duplicate or incorrect payments. An account can be hibernated instead, which cuts the subscription cost by 70%.


## Who JustCall fits and who it does not


JustCall's pricing page describes Team as a business phone system with CRM integrations. That fits a team of two or more that wants calling, texting, IVR and CRM sync in one tool.


Pro fits a team that wants a power dialer at a published price. JustCall's[campaign guide](https://help.justcall.io/en/articles/10520971-choosing-the-right-sales-dialer-campaign) says it dials one number at a time for a single agent. SalesPro fits an outbound team that wants a predictive dialer of up to 10 lines and will get a quote for it.


JustCall is a weaker fit for a single user, since every plan bills at least two licenses. It is also a weaker fit for a buyer who needs a public price for multi-line dialing, because SalesPro is quoted. A buyer who takes the sale price should plan for renewal at the standard price.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does JustCall cost per user?


At regular prices, Team is $29, Pro $49 and Pro Plus $89 per user a month billed annually, or $39, $69 and $109 billed monthly. Every plan needs at least two licenses. Business and SalesPro are quoted.


### What are JustCall's Black Friday prices in 2026?


On November 17, 2026, JustCall's pricing page showed Team at $23, Pro at $37 and Pro Plus at $62 per user a month on annual billing. The regular annual prices are $29, $49 and $89. The sale ends on November 30, 2026, covers new annual plans, and renews at the standard annual price after 12 months.


### What is the minimum number of JustCall licenses?


Two on Team, Pro, Pro Plus and SalesPro, and 10 on Business. The minimum applies on monthly and annual billing. One person on Team with monthly billing pays for two licenses, which is $78 a month.


### Does JustCall have a free trial?


Yes. JustCall offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card, on SalesPro features. Its trial guide caps calling at 50 outbound and 50 inbound minutes, with 7 minutes a call. You can subscribe during the trial or within 30 days after it ends.


### Which JustCall plan includes a dialer?


The pricing page lists the power dialer from Pro, at $49 per user a month on regular annual billing or $69 monthly. The predictive dialer of up to 10 lines and the dynamic dialer are listed on SalesPro, which is quoted. Team lists no dialer.
